description: A React component for a modal list interface with pagination, search, and customizable row rendering, used within the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: ListModal
classes.description: A React component class for displaying a modal with a list of groups, supporting pagination, search, and custom row rendering.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial items and total count when the component mounts.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Calls the onHide callback if provided when the modal exits.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders either a loading screen or the list of items using the renderRow prop.

methods.name: onPrev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page.

methods.name: onPageChange
methods.description: Loads items for the specified page and updates state.

methods.name: onSearchInput
methods.description: Handles search input changes, triggers loading of filtered items.

methods.name: paginationRange
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current start and end count for pagination display.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal component with header, search box, list, and pagination controls.
